svg.title: Srinivasan: backend, machine learning and agents
svg.desc: I build backend services, ML pipelines and AI agents. Mostly Python and Java: Spring Boot APIs, computer vision, and local models wired into agent loops. Computer Science at KIIT, 2024–2028. The name is set in textured cobalt over drifting black and ivory stripes, with a rotating four-dimensional cube behind it.
